# Solution Engineering

Use this skill for the full lifecycle or when deciding which phase should run.

## Procedure

1. Classify input and choose mode.
2. If requirements are not stable, run requirement phase.
3. Freeze requirements only after explicit approval.
4. Curate architecture inputs from frozen requirements, tech stack, principles, constraints, and decisions.
5. Create architecture, AID, ServiceNow design, data model, ERDs, and review artifacts as needed.
6. Baseline only after explicit approval.

**Why?** One workflow controls the lifecycle while specialists keep each artifact strong.
